ingredients.item: spring onions, sliced on the diagonal

steps.text: Whisk the miso, mirin, sake, sugar, and sesame oil to a smooth, glossy glaze.
Turn the salmon in half the glaze and leave it skin side down. Keep the rest of the glaze back.
Rinse the rice in cold water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
Bring the rice and the measured water to a boil in a lidded pan, then drop the heat to its lowest.
Cook it covered, without once lifting the lid, until the water has all been taken up.
Slide the pan off the heat and leave the lid on. The rice finishes in its own steam.
Heat the grill to high and line a tray with foil. Lift the salmon out and let the excess drip off.
Grill the salmon skin side down until the top is lacquered and blistered in places.
Warm the held-back glaze with the rice vinegar and a splash of water until it just loosens.
Fork the rice through to separate the grains and spoon it into four bowls.
Sit the salmon on the rice, spoon over the warm glaze, and finish with the spring onions and sesame.
